verdict.rationale: Creating a virtual display on the host is a fair capability to ask of a remote-desktop product like TeamViewer, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions virtual displays, headless rendering, or keeping covered windows rendering. The pack covers pricing, APIs, device management, AR and AI features, and community complaints, none of which address this story.

support.subject: As a power user, the host can create a virtual display, so a streamed window keeps rendering when covered or the machine runs headless
